# Athena release notes

Release notes aim to follow the [ASD-STE100 technical-English policy](../skills/TECHNICAL_ENGLISH.md).

Install Athena through its Git-backed skill or plugin source. Installation and invocation commands
depend on the coding harness. The root [`README.md`](../README.md) gives the general instructions.

Each release includes a checksummed portable plugin archive. Use it for offline distribution.

The archive contains only these items:

- skills that coding harnesses use;
- host manifests and marketplace metadata;
- runtime documentation;
- assets; and
- legal notices.

The archive excludes these items:

- tests;
- repository scripts;
- development manifests and lockfiles;
- task-runner files;
- continuous integration (CI) configuration;
- caches; and
- generated development output.

The archive is not a Python package. It does not replace a Git-backed marketplace installation.


## What's Changed
* chore(security): renew the brace-expansion exceptions to 2026-12-04 by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/395
* fix(pr-review): deliver a carrier whose reframe retired its fallback batch by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/398
* fix(issue-exchange): accept closed details blocks with code by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/400
* chore(ci): bump pi-subagents to 0.83.1 in ci/pi-runtime by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/401
* chore(ci): bump the minor-patch GitHub Actions group by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/402
* fix(pr-review): recover one malformed immutable anchor annex by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/403
* feat(review): make record-shape and staleness findings delivery warnings by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/390
* fix(review-exchange): accept a changed-head author refresh after a complete GO by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/405
* fix(pr-review): deliver the retained annex and replay author events faithfully by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/406
* chore(security): consolidate Pi runtime vulnerability tracking by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/408
* fix(plan-issue): preserve exact plan publication bytes by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/409
* refactor(skills): make reviews non-binding and goal-oriented by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/411
* fix(skills): address pr-review follow-up findings by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/412
* chore(security): record CVE-2026-119170 python 3.14.10 exception by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/416
* refactor(skills): harden review delivery follow-ups by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/414
* chore(release): bump manifests to 0.7.0 by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/417
* test(skills): restore the 80 percent branch-coverage floor by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/418


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/compare/v0.6.2...v0.7.0
